author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.
  
  
References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.aboutwayfair.com/careers/tech-blog

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager I
job_description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking for an experienced **Sr. Product Manager I** to join our Product Organization at Smartsheet to support our **Digital Asset Management offering - Brandfolder** by Smartsheet.

You'll report to our General Manager - Brandfolder and collaborate with passionate teams across the globe.

**You Will:**

* Contribute to the vision and strategy for Brandfolder, informed by company objectives, customer needs, and industry best practices
* Own the roadmap for a defined set of Brandfolder capabilities, partnering with technical and product leaders across Smartsheet to align with broader platform investments
* Work closely with design and engineering to deliver compelling, high-quality customer experiences from discovery through launch
* Use internal and external data to guide experimentation, prioritization, and evaluation of success
* Partner with research, product design, data science, and analytics teams to run experiments and test prototypes to validate hypotheses
* Communicate product direction, capabilities, experiment results, and insights to cross-functional stakeholders
* Operate at both the strategic and tactical levels, building strong cross-team partnerships that drive shared success for the product area
* Support other duties as needed

**You Have:**

* 4-6+ years of product management experience
* Experience delivering a delightful user experience on a scalable platform
* Experience with agile development methodologies and frequent product releases
* Experience delivering complex enterprise software products from inception to launch
* Experience working on content-related products such as DAMs (preferred but not required)
* Data-driven mentality with a focus on metrics and analytics
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Technical degree, or equivalent experience working with engineers to make product decisions on behalf of customers (MBA preferred but not required)

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager-I
job_description:
**About MoEngage:**

MoEngage is an insights-led customer engagement platform trusted by 1,350+ global consumer brands, including McAfee, Flipkart, Domino’s, Nestle, Deutsche Telekom, and OYO. MoEngage combines data from multiple sources to help brands gain a 360-degree view of their customers.

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior. Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1:1 conversations across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage’s AI Suite helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution.

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™ 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023.

**About the Role**  
Messaging is where marketing actually meets the customer — the push that gets opened, the WhatsApp that gets replied to, the SMS that drives the click. You'll own a slice of the Campaigns product — the engine behind messaging across Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and In-App channels — and be judged on whether customers actually adopt what you ship, not on how well you followed the spec someone else wrote.  
You're a few years into your PM career, not new to it. You've shipped things end-to-end, learned what "done" actually means in practice, and know the difference between a feature customers use every day and a feature that only exists in a release note.  
You'll report into the Campaigns product team, work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design, and spend a meaningful chunk of your week talking to customers, reading support threads, and digging through usage data — because that's where the real opportunities live, not in a brainstorm.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Customer Research, Relentlessly-** Run structured VoC/VoP analysis — customer calls, support ticket audits, CSM conversations, in-app feedback — to build a constantly-updated picture of where Campaigns is winning and where it's losing deals or trust. Turn scattered anecdotes into a ranked list of real problems.
* **Opportunity Mining-** Don't wait for a PRD to land in your inbox. Mine support channels, churn signals, and feature requests to surface the 2-3 gaps that matter most this quarter — and defend why those and not the other twenty.
* **Execution, End to End-** From decision-anchored PRD to shipped feature — write the spec, resolve edge cases, sit in every standup that matters, unblock engineering, and make trade-off calls when scope and timeline collide. Ideas are cheap; shipped is the job.
* **Adoption Is the Metric-** Shipping isn't done at code-complete. Partner with CS, Sales, and Marketing to drive activation — enablement decks, in-app nudges, customer outreach — and own the adoption number, not just the release note.
* **Voice of the Customer, Internally-** Be the translator between "what customers are saying" and "what we build next." Feed structured research back into prioritization debates and hold the team accountable to solving the problem, not just the ticket.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Evidence you've owned something end-to-end — from problem discovery to shipped, adopted feature — not just been on the team that did.
* Sharp customer instincts, and the willingness to keep earning them by talking to actual users every single week.
* A clear thinker and clearer writer; you can turn a messy problem into a one-pager that gets a decision made.

**Bonus points**

* Experience in Martech / Customer Engagement / Marketing Automation.
* Familiarity with messaging channels (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Push) as a builder or a heavy operator.
* Comfort with API-driven or platform products, and the ambiguity that comes with them.

At MoEngage, we respect and value differences. We believe that when people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives collaborate, we create the most value – for our clients, our employees, and society. We embrace diversity and uphold a strong set of values. We are committed to inclusivity and take pride in providing equal opportunities for success and growth.

Employment at MoEngage is based solely on professional competence, skills, and experience. We stand firmly against all forms of discrimination and support equal rights and opportunities regardless of gender, ethnicity, abilities, age, identity, orientation or expression, marital status (including pregnancy), religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by law.

It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws related to non-discrimination and equal opportunity. MoEngage is truly a place where everyone can bring their passions, authentic selves, and talents to work, collaborating to drive progress and solve meaningful challenges.

  

**Why Join Us!**

At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology - see below to know more about us.

Life@MoEngage

Tech@MoEngage

Scale @MoEngage

We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world-class technology team.

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior. Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1:1 conversations across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage’s AI Suite helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution.

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™ 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023.

**About the Role**  
Messaging is where marketing actually meets the customer — the push that gets opened, the WhatsApp that gets replied to, the SMS that drives the click. You'll own a slice of the Campaigns product — the engine behind messaging across Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and In-App channels — and be judged on whether customers actually adopt what you ship, not on how well you followed the spec someone else wrote.  
You're a few years into your PM career, not new to it. You've shipped things end-to-end, learned what "done" actually means in practice, and know the difference between a feature customers use every day and a feature that only exists in a release note.  
You'll report into the Campaigns product team, work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design, and spend a meaningful chunk of your week talking to customers, reading support threads, and digging through usage data — because that's where the real opportunities live, not in a brainstorm.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Customer Research, Relentlessly-** Run structured VoC/VoP analysis — customer calls, support ticket audits, CSM conversations, in-app feedback — to build a constantly-updated picture of where Campaigns is winning and where it's losing deals or trust. Turn scattered anecdotes into a ranked list of real problems.
* **Opportunity Mining-** Don't wait for a PRD to land in your inbox. Mine support channels, churn signals, and feature requests to surface the 2-3 gaps that matter most this quarter — and defend why those and not the other twenty.
* **Execution, End to End-** From decision-anchored PRD to shipped feature — write the spec, resolve edge cases, sit in every standup that matters, unblock engineering, and make trade-off calls when scope and timeline collide. Ideas are cheap; shipped is the job.
* **Adoption Is the Metric-** Shipping isn't done at code-complete. Partner with CS, Sales, and Marketing to drive activation — enablement decks, in-app nudges, customer outreach — and own the adoption number, not just the release note.
* **Voice of the Customer, Internally-** Be the translator between "what customers are saying" and "what we build next." Feed structured research back into prioritization debates and hold the team accountable to solving the problem, not just the ticket.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Evidence you've owned something end-to-end — from problem discovery to shipped, adopted feature — not just been on the team that did.
* Sharp customer instincts, and the willingness to keep earning them by talking to actual users every single week.
* A clear thinker and clearer writer; you can turn a messy problem into a one-pager that gets a decision made.

**Bonus points**

* Experience in Martech / Customer Engagement / Marketing Automation.
* Familiarity with messaging channels (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Push) as a builder or a heavy operator.
* Comfort with API-driven or platform products, and the ambiguity that comes with them.

At MoEngage, we respect and value differences. We believe that when people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives collaborate, we create the most value – for our clients, our employees, and society. We embrace diversity and uphold a strong set of values. We are committed to inclusivity and take pride in providing equal opportunities for success and growth.

Employment at MoEngage is based solely on professional competence, skills, and experience. We stand firmly against all forms of discrimination and support equal rights and opportunities regardless of gender, ethnicity, abilities, age, identity, orientation or expression, marital status (including pregnancy), religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by law.

It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws related to non-discrimination and equal opportunity. MoEngage is truly a place where everyone can bring their passions, authentic selves, and talents to work, collaborating to drive progress and solve meaningful challenges.

  

**Why Join Us!**

At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology - see below to know more about us.

Life@MoEngage

Tech@MoEngage

Scale @MoEngage

We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world-class technology team.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.

As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.

Visa is seeking a seasoned Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.

As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.

Responsibilities:

* Customer-Centric Product Vision: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* 5+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 2+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, development, and scaling of next-generation healthcare data and AI-driven products. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, analytics, and operations, translating complex healthcare challenges into innovative digital solutions that improve clinical, operational, and member outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong product management expertise, technical depth, healthcare domain knowledge, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business value.

You will partner with engineering, architecture, data science, operations, and business stakeholders to define product vision, prioritize investments, and drive adoption of scalable solutions that support strategic healthcare initiatives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Vision
  + Define and execute short and long-term product strategies, roadmaps, and investment priorities for healthcare technology products and platforms
  + Partner with business leaders, customers, and technology teams to identify opportunities that improve healthcare outcomes, operational efficiency, and business performance
  + Translate strategic objectives into product capabilities, business cases, and prioritized delivery plans
  + Define product success metrics, KPIs, customer outcomes, and value realization measures
* Product Ownership & Delivery
  + Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation, discovery, and definition through launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement
  + Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans
  + Prioritize and manage product backlogs to maximize customer value and business impact
  + Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements
  + Monitor product performance and continuously refine priorities based on data, customer feedback, and market insights
* Healthcare Data & AI Enablement
  + Drive development of healthcare data products, analytics platforms, AI/ML capabilities, and intelligent automation solutions
  + Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to define data acquisition, integration, governance, analytics, and consumption strategies
  + Identify opportunities to leverage generative AI, predictive analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve workflows and decision-making
  + Define requirements for APIs, interoperability solutions, reporting platforms, and healthcare data services
  + Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and regulatory requirements are embedded within product designs
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, operations, and leadership
  + Facilitate alignment across multiple teams and portfolios to deliver integrated product solutions
  + Influence priorities and drive decisions in a complex matrixed environment without direct authority
  + Communicate product vision, roadmap, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leaders and stakeholders

  + Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and prioritization activities
  + Ensure product initiatives are decomposed into actionable features and well-defined user stories

* Experience delivering enterprise-scale technology products, platforms, or data-driven solutions
* Experience working with cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, data platforms, analytics, and digital technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, analytics, data science, and business teams
* Experience using product management and Agile tools such as Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product capabilities, business processes, or customer experiences
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and modern product management practices
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions
* Demonstrated solid analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex cross-functional dependencies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within healthcare, payer, provider, population health, payment integrity, claims, clinical, or healthcare analytics domains
* Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics products
* Experience with cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems
* Experience leading large-scale digital transformation or enterprise modernization initiatives
* Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, customer adoption metrics, and business value outcomes
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards, interoperability, governance, privacy, and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with healthcare operational workflows, clinical programs, and digital health solutions
* Solid understanding of product portfolio management, roadmap planning, and investment prioritization
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive alignment across complex organizations

title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms
job_description:
Posted date Oct. 21, 2026

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-262359

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262359 **Date posted** 10/21/2026

**Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms**

**GCL: E**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.

You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?

Accountabilities:

* Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
* Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and related DevOps services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
* Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
* Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
* Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
* Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, DevSecOps practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
* Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

Essential Skills/Experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
* They will bring strong expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
* They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
* The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
* Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
* Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
* This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
* Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

* Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, including GxP, would be helpful.
* Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Here, platform decisions turn into real-world impact for patients. We bring surprising combinations of guides together to reinvent how data, machine learning and modern engineering accelerate discovery and delivery. You will shape the backbone that powers science at scale—working with leading specialists, pushing forward with a multifaceted operating model, and learning fast without compromising on doing things the right way. We value grit alongside ambition, coupling high standards with genuine support so you can take bold bets, see your work recognized, and grow your craft while improving lives.

Step in to lead the DevOps platforms within the enterprise that accelerate science. Take ownership of the portfolio and help us build the future of delivery.

**Date Posted**

21-Oct-2026

**Closing Date**

05-Nov-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

**What we offer**
-----------------

We're driven by our shared values of serving people, society and the planet. Our people make this possible, which is why we prioritise diversity, safety, empowerment and collaboration. Discover what a career at AstraZeneca could mean for you.

### **Lifelong learning**

Our development opportunities are second to none. You'll have the chance to grow your abilities, skills and knowledge constantly as you accelerate your career. From leadership projects and constructive coaching to overseas talent exchanges and global collaboration programmes, you'll never stand still.

### **Autonomy and reward**

Experience the power of shaping your career how you want to. We are a high-performing learning organisation with autonomy over how we learn. Make big decisions, learn from your mistakes and continue growing — with performance-based rewards as part of the package.

### **Health and wellbeing**

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-262359

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262359 **Date posted** 10/21/2026

**Job Title: Senior Product Manager – Enterprise DevOps Platforms**

**GCL: E**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to build and scale a comprehensive DevOps infrastructure that 20,000–30,000 users depend on to move life-changing science to patients faster! This is your opportunity to set the strategy for tools and services that power developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and raise the quality of decision-making across the company. You will feel the sponsorship behind the mission and see the impact of your choices recognized at the highest levels.

You will lead with both vision and execution—bridging business priorities, user experience, engineering capability, oversight, and organizational standards to build a cohesive platform backbone. Working with guides in software development, cybersecurity, system build, and data, you will align Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and adjacent services into a secure, scalable, AI-enabled ecosystem. Do you thrive on connecting strategic direction with pragmatic delivery to unlock productivity at scale?

Accountabilities:

* Portfolio Product Strategy and Vision: Define and drive the product strategy, vision, and roadmap across the enterprise DevOps platform portfolio, aligning business priorities, engineering needs, platform evolution, and enterprise architecture standards to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead and develop Product Owners across multiple products; set direction, clarify accountabilities, set objectives, coach, handle performance, and build a high-performing, outcome-focused culture.
* Connected Platform Ecosystem: Manage Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Copilot and related DevOps services as an integrated ecosystem, not isolated tools; align roadmaps, priorities, and service improvements to support a coherent enterprise strategy.
* Portfolio Prioritization and Direction: Run portfolio-level prioritization that balances business value, user needs, adoption, operational sustainability, security, compliance, and long-term platform health; translate strategy into clear direction and support Product Owners in delivering agreed outcomes.
* Enterprise-Scale Adoption: Drive large-scale adoption and effective usage across 20,000–30,000 users; remove barriers, improve usability and accessibility, and partner with engineering coaches, platform teams, and business collaborators to increase engagement and realized value.
* Ensure platforms are delivered as scalable, supportable, and maintainable enterprise-grade services. Align these services with policies, governance, and the overall organizational system build. Promote standardization, consolidation, and simplification to reduce fragmentation.
* Security by Build and Governance: Embed security-by-design, DevSecOps practices, least privilege principles, and regulatory expectations across the portfolio; ensure secure defaults and appropriate governance in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, and compliance.
* Senior Collaborator Engagement and Influence: Engage senior leaders across business and technology to understand priorities, reconcile differing needs, and influence decisions; act as a senior extension business, product, engineering, and governance.

Essential Skills/Experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate significant experience in a product management leadership role such as Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Product Lead, or a similar position within a technical, platform, or enterprise tooling environment.
* They will bring strong expertise in DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, developer workflows, and enterprise platform product management, together with experience operating across a sophisticated collaborator environment.
* They will also have confirmed experience in formal people management, including leading, coaching, and developing Product Owners or product professionals within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
* The role requires proven experience in leading teams across various products or services, with the ability to build clarity, alignment, and consistency in delivery and product practices.
* Candidates should have a consistent track record of leading central initiatives, influencing across departments, and delivering outcomes in environments where challenges span multiple teams or functional areas. They should be comfortable operating independently, crafting direction, and combining critical thinking with pragmatic execution.
* Experience in portfolio-level product management is critical, including balancing short-term delivery priorities with long-term strategic value across multiple offerings or solutions.
* This position demands demonstrated capability to drive adoption across large user populations, ideally in environments with 10,000+ users. It also requires improving effective usage through product thinking, change enablement, and engaging collaborators.
* Strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills are critical. If you are able to independently persuade internal and external collaborators, often where priorities conflict, and build alignment around roadmap direction, investment decisions, and product outcomes.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

* Experience with enterprise platforms and tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Artifactory would be valuable.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, is desirable.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, including GxP, would be helpful.
* Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives or defining AI strategy within enterprise platforms would be advantageous.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Here, platform decisions turn into real-world impact for patients. We bring surprising combinations of guides together to reinvent how data, machine learning and modern engineering accelerate discovery and delivery. You will shape the backbone that powers science at scale—working with leading specialists, pushing forward with a multifaceted operating model, and learning fast without compromising on doing things the right way. We value grit alongside ambition, coupling high standards with genuine support so you can take bold bets, see your work recognized, and grow your craft while improving lives.

Step in to lead the DevOps platforms within the enterprise that accelerate science. Take ownership of the portfolio and help us build the future of delivery.

title: Senior Software Product Manager
job_description:
### **About Us**

Phenom Cloud is not your average consultancy. HR is our home turf: we help clients solve their trickiest people-tech puzzles with smart, innovative solutions, backed by strong partnerships with leading HR technology vendors. Our clients operate in complex, highly regulated industries such as advanced manufacturing, life sciences, pharma, retail, and financial services, where "trusted relationship" is a real requirement, not a buzzword in a pitch deck.

What really sets us apart is our people. We know our stuff, we don't take ourselves too seriously, and yes, we are genuinely fun to be around (our clients said so, and we didn't even pay them). Through it all, we keep client excellence at the heart of everything we do. We are not a quick fling: we are a reliable, credible partner who remembers our clients' birthdays, shows up on time, and is still around years later.

### **Position Summary**

If that sounds like your kind of place, and you're a product leader who loves turning great ideas into great software (and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves to make it happen), we should talk.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Product Management** professional to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of Phenom Cloud's expanding portfolio of enterprise software products, including innovative AI-powered solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages roadmaps, attends sprint reviews, and asks engineering for status updates. We need someone who takes real ownership, understands how software actually works, knows what customers need, and can turn product challenges into opportunities.

You'll have end-to-end accountability for product strategy, quality, prioritization, and delivery. That means quickly understanding our existing products, identifying what needs improvement, establishing clear priorities, and working closely with engineering to turn requirements into software that actually delivers.

But this isn't just about making products work better. It's about making them more valuable. You'll study the market, understand competitors, identify opportunities for differentiation, and help shape products customers genuinely want to buy.

You'll work directly with executive leadership, collaborate across product and engineering teams, and have meaningful influence over the direction of our software business. We're a growing company, so expect to wear multiple hats. If your ideal role involves a large team handling all the details while you focus exclusively on strategy, this probably isn't your gig.

**For the right entrepreneurial product leader, this is a rare opportunity to take real ownership, make a visible impact, and help scale an innovative software portfolio without navigating layers of corporate bureaucracy.**

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, quality, prioritization, and overall success of Phenom Cloud's software product portfolio
* Quickly assess existing products, identify functional gaps and usability issues, and drive improvements that make a real difference to customers
* Establish clear product priorities, balancing critical fixes, customer needs, technical considerations, and strategic enhancements
* Lead and coordinate product management activities, providing direction, accountability, and oversight across the product lifecycle
* Partner closely with engineering to translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Drive agile execution through sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and release readiness. We're big fans of shipping great software, not just talking about it
* Ensure delivered functionality meets requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations
* Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for innovation, differentiation, and commercial growth
* Develop and execute product roadmaps that connect customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives
* Collaborate with customers, sales, marketing, and delivery teams to gather feedback, shape product direction, and support go-to-market activities
* Identify opportunities to expand product capabilities, introduce new offerings, and grow recurring software revenue
* Establish practical, scalable product management processes without turning a fast-moving company into a bureaucracy

### **Skills & Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in software product management, technical product ownership, or a closely related role
* Proven experience managing software products through requirements, development, testing, release, and continuous improvement
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint management, backlog prioritization, and software development lifecycles
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Strong technical aptitude and the confidence to challenge engineering assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and get into the details when needed
* Experience diagnosing product issues, prioritizing improvements, and driving problems through to resolution
* Strong commercial instincts and the ability to connect product strategy with customer needs, competitive positioning, and business growth
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when things aren't neatly documented or clearly defined
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, establish accountability, and keep development moving without needing a small army of project managers
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action. You'd rather solve a problem than schedule another meeting to discuss it
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage confidently with engineers, customers, and executives alike
* Ability to use AI to improve productivity and accelerate product development without sacrificing independent thinking, creativity, or sound judgment
* A genuinely great teammate who is collaborative, approachable, and fun to work with. We value smart people with small egos and a sense of humor

### **Some Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or subscription-based products
* Background in HR technology, learning management systems, talent management, or workforce technology
* Experience with AI-powered products, workflow automation, or enterprise software integrations
* Track record of launching, scaling, or commercializing software products
* Experience leading product owners, product managers, or cross-functional development teams
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools
* Experience in a startup, scale-up, or entrepreneurial software environment where wearing multiple hats comes with the territory

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401K)
* Remote working
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Opportunity to take full ownership of a growing software portfolio and directly influence product strategy, innovation, and commercial success
* Direct access to executive leadership and meaningful influence over the growth and direction of our software business
* Career growth opportunities as our software portfolio and product organization continue to scale
* Creative, entrepreneurial environment where decisions happen quickly, great ideas are encouraged, and bureaucracy is kept to a minimum
* Surround yourself with people who are great at what they do and even better at not taking themselves too seriously

**Company Description**

**Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description**

Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR) is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and mobility software, we've pioneered BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading to a groundbreaking shift in how companies approach their treasury reserve strategy, boldly adopting Bitcoin as a key asset. This visionary move is reshaping the financial landscape and solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market. Four years after adopting the Bitcoin Standard, Strategy's stock has outperformed every company in S&P 500.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee; you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build next-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high-impact products.

You will own the product end-to-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high-performing, differentiated products.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery & Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap & Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution & Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high-quality products
* **Adoption & Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

**How You Think**

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end-to-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

**Additional Information**

The recruitment process includes online assessments as a first step (English, logic, design) - we send them via e-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

author: Hiring Manager
title: Digital Product Manager -VP
job_description:
Date live: 10/21/2026

Business Area: Digital & Innovation

Area of Expertise: Product Development & Management

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000108227

  

Join us as a Senior Digital Product Owner - Digital Help & AI at Barclays where you'll be responsible for owning and enhancing the Digital Help experience across the mobile banking app and digital channels, with a focus on self-service tools and customer support journeys. You'll work closely with Product Owners and Product Managers to deliver activities that improve how customers access help and support digitally. This role will support the launch and evolution of integrated AI capabilities, including new features within the app and AI-assisted experiences. You'll take ownership of the customer journey, ensuring digital help solutions are intuitive, effective, and aligned to customer needs.

To be successful as a Senior Digital Product Owner - Digital Help & AI, you must have the following essential skills:

* Product ownership: Experience identifying customer needs through data and research, prioritising problems to solve based on business and customer value, and owning products from discovery through to post-launch optimisation.
* Delivery expertise: Proven ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both live customer journeys and new features.
* Data literacy: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear and concise insights or business cases.
* Risk and controls: Understanding of risk and control frameworks, with the ability to ensure effective risk management and mitigation throughout product delivery.
* Stakeholder management: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams - including engineers, designers, intelligence teams, and control functions - and stakeholders across the UK and India.
* Financial services experience: Experience working within the financial services industry, with an understanding of the UK regulatory, risk, and customer environment.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* AI Knowledge: Understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI products, including awareness of the governance, risk, and control frameworks required to deliver these solutions safely and responsibly

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Pune, India.

**Purpose of the role**

To manage and drive the innovation strategy to meet customer needs and ensure the bank's long-term success and competitive edge.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of market research to understand customer needs, pain points, and emerging trends to support the analysis of profitability, market size and positioning for new products compared to existing offerings, and to identify opportunities for diversification to gain a competitive advantage.
* Collaboration with stakeholders across departments and teams including marketing, sales, technology, engineers, designers etc to generate innovative and feasible product ideas and prototypes for testing aligned with customer needs and strategic goals.
* Development of concepts and specifications which define features, functionalities, target market, user interface, technical specifications and potential revenue models of new products.
* Evaluation of the technical feasibility, legal compliance, and potential risks associated with the development and launch of the new product.
* Monitoring of market trends and analysis feedback from internal employees and target customers through prototypes, user testing sessions, and beta programs to identify areas for improvement to refine the product before launch.
* Management of comprehensive launch plans and technical deployments for products that establish rollout timelines, marketing strategies, training initiatives and communication channels to promote the launch new products effectively.
* Monitoring of key metrics such as adoption rates, usage patterns, customer satisfaction, and revenue generation to assess the product's performance against set goals.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Principal Product Manager
job_description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Product Manager**
=============================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Principal Product Manager – Labor Market Intelligence**

**About the Role:**

Cornerstone's Intelligence+ portfolio is building the workforce intelligence layer for the world's largest organizations — connecting skills, roles, people, and external labor market data into a single decision-making fabric. At the heart of this is a family of analytics and insight products that turn complex, multi-source data into trusted answers for enterprise leaders.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to bring Labor Market Intelligence (LMI) into the heart of our workforce intelligence product — owning how labor market data and models become customer-facing analytics, visualization, and decision experiences across the Intelligence+ platform. You'll work in close partnership with the data science team that owns the underlying LMI models.

This is a senior IC role for a PM who has built data analytics products — not just shipped software. You know what it takes to earn user trust in a number on a screen: data quality, methodology transparency, the right visualization for the right question, and AI/ML that is explainable rather than magical.

**In this role you will...**

* Own how the Labor Market Intelligence offering is embedded into the workforce intelligence product — shaping the roadmap for LMI-powered experiences from data ingestion through customer-facing analytics.
* Partner with data science on ML models, taxonomy mapping, normalization, and inference — defining evaluation criteria and making explainability a product requirement, not an afterthought.
* Collaborate with product teams across the portfolio to bring labor market signal into their own surfaces and workflows.
* Design insight and visualization experiences that make complex workforce and market data legible and decision-ready.
* Define the analytics measurement framework for the product itself: adoption, insight quality, and demonstrable customer value.
* Work directly with enterprise customers to shape requirements, run pilots, and convert feedback into product direction.
* Drive GTM readiness with field enablement, packaging, and positioning — including consultative, services-led delivery models.
* Operate as an internal and external thought leader on data-driven decision making and AI-powered workforce intelligence.

**You've got what it takes if you have…**

* 8+ years of product management experience with wide-ranging expertise, operating at Principal/Lead scope — you determine methods and approaches on new initiatives independently and guide the work of others.
* Demonstrated experience building data analytics and visualization products — BI, people analytics, market intelligence, or similar — where the data itself was the product.
* Genuine AI/ML product depth: you've shipped features built on models, worked with data scientists on training data, evaluation, and inference quality, and can reason about tradeoffs between deterministic and probabilistic approaches.
* Experience limited to managing a standard software development lifecycle is not sufficient for this role.
* Strong personal analytical fluency — you can pull the data yourself, sanity-check a methodology, and challenge a dashboard's framing.
* Experience with enterprise B2B customers, including executive-level stakeholder management
* Excellent written communication — PR/FAQs, customer narratives, and technical specs with equal fluency.
* Hands-on, daily use of AI tools — LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic workflows — to prototype, analyze data, and ship faster; you model AI-native ways of working and raise the bar for how the team builds.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building: you'd rather put a working prototype in front of a customer than a slide.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with LLM-based features and agentic product experiences.
* Prior experience in HCM, talent intelligence, or people analytics platforms.
* Exposure to compliance considerations for AI products (EU AI Act, data privacy).

**Why This Role:**

You'll own a product with direct executive visibility, an enterprise customer base, and a central role in Cornerstone's AI strategy — shaping how enterprises understand and act on their workforce and the market around it.

#LI-OnSite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!
