author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Product Manager
job_description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* **Using AI.** Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* **Supporting sales and delivery.** Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* **Guiding customers off legacy.** Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

**For US candidates:** A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.

**For non-US candidates:** A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.

We offer:

* **Real impact.** Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* **Modern stack.** Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* **Direct customer contact.** You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* **Growth.** GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.

**Working Arrangement**
-----------------------

Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager with experience building B2C consumer internet products. Someone who understands users, can identify the right problems to solve, and knows how to take a product from an idea to launch.

At FOXO, you'll work closely with founders, designers, engineers, and business teams to shape the product roadmap and turn business priorities into products that people find useful and want to keep using.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and being involved in every stage of product development, from understanding user needs to launching features and improving them based on feedback and data.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own product initiatives from discovery and planning to launch and ongoing improvements.
* Work with founders and leadership to define product priorities and build the roadmap.
* Speak to users, gather feedback, and use product data to understand what needs to improve.
* Turn business requirements and user problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Design and Engineering to build and ship products that are easy to use.
* Identify ways to improve user onboarding, conversion, engagement, and retention.
* Prioritise features based on user needs, business impact, and engineering effort.
* Define product metrics and track how features perform after launch.
* Run experiments and A/B tests to understand what works and what doesn't.
* Study user journeys and drop-off points to identify areas for improvement.

job_description:
**Overview**

Role: **Senior Product Manager**

Build the commerce engine that powers Copilot's growth.

Every great growth idea, a new offer, a smarter trial, a better upgrade, ends in the same place: a purchase that has to feel effortless and work flawlessly, on every device. You will own the commerce foundations behind Copilot, so that anyone who chooses to pay gets instant access to what they bought, and growth teams can turn a new idea into a live offer in days. This is a growth role disguised as a platform role: the systems you build decide how fast the whole organization can learn.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, for consumers and businesses alike. Monetization is moving inside the product, with new plans, add-ons and usage-based offers arriving quickly. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is live across iOS and Android. That makes commerce one of the highest-leverage places to build right now.

How we work

* Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if…

* You sweat the details of a great purchase moment.
* You know revenue is won or lost in receipts, retries, renewals and edge cases.
* You read API contracts like specs and write your own queries instead of waiting for dashboards.
* You can sketch the state machine for a purchase across store, service and app.
* You move teams you don't manage with clear asks, crisp escalations and a lot of goodwill.
* You form a view, test it and change your mind when the data says so.

This role may not be for you if…

* You want a fully defined backlog handed to you every cycle.
* You prefer strategy decks to working through a tricky purchase flow with engineers.
* Ambiguity across many partner teams drains you rather than motivates you.

Why join us

Few roles give you this much leverage: the commerce foundations you build will shape how millions of people and businesses buy and experience AI. You will own a critical platform for a global product, with the trust to set direction and a fast-moving, AI-native team beside you. If that excites you, we would love to meet you.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

What you will own

As the dedicated owner of commerce for Copilot Growth, your mission is to make commerce an experimentation platform: growth teams launch new offers and price tests as configuration, not bespoke engineering.

* Offers and entitlements: a clean model for plans, bundles and add-ons, wired correctly from day one.
* Effortless purchase: checkout and purchase flows across web, desktop and mobile, including self-service purchase for businesses.
* Instant access: entitlement that reaches the customer the moment they pay.
* Trials and offers: configurable, targetable and measurable without waiting for an app release.
* App store billing: purchase, renewal and receipts on iOS, Android and Mac, in close partnership with store platforms.
* Usage and recovery: usage-based metering and smooth payment recovery.
* Measurement everywhere: telemetry and experimentation hooks so every commerce change is measured.

You will partner with platform, engineering, finance, tax, legal and store teams, and move metrics such as purchase success, time to access, checkout conversion and experiment lead time.

Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days

* First 30 days: understand every purchase path end to end, and the data and partners behind it.
* By 60 days: a hypothesis-led commerce roadmap your partners back.
* By 90 days: a first improvement shipped, and a growth team launching an offer on your foundations.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in product management or software development.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Significant experience with commerce, payments, billing, subscriptions or platform products at scale.
* Solid technical depth: API contracts, data schemas, SQL and purchase edge cases.
* Experimentation literacy and a track record of delivering outcomes through teams you don't own.
* App store billing experience (StoreKit, Google Play Billing), including receipt validation.
* Entitlement or licensing systems, or B2B SaaS licensing.
* Fintech, payments or e-commerce experience, including UPI and checkout optimization.
* Pricing and offer engines, SQL or Kusto (KQL), and mentoring other PMs.

#CAPIDC

#DPG

#DPGHiring

#Growth

#IDCMicrosoft

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Sr. Staff Product Manager
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Join the ProTax Desktop team as a Product Manager, where you will foster an environment of technology innovation and customer obsession. In this role, you will be building technologies to enable ta professionals to confidently prepare and file their customers’ taxes using our desktop software. You will be a leader for the ProTax Desktop US and Canada teams, delivering core capabilities for Intuit customers and products around the world, and playing a crucial role in driving customer benefit, growth, and long-term differentiation for the company. You will lead product strategy for the organization, partnering closely with technology and design leaders across Intuit businesses. You will help drive the product vision to power the ProTax Desktop ecosystem across the US and Canada.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the definition and execution of a product roadmap that supports the delivery of our ProTax Desktop experiences.
* Leverage data to prioritize opportunities and focus on the most impactful problems affecting our customers and business.
* Define and create test plans to validate key hypotheses, improve conversion, and drive KPIs.
* Partner closely with design and engineering to craft simple, high-converting user experiences that bring clarity to a complex service.
* Build strong relationships with senior leaders across Intuit to align on priorities, share insights, and co-create roadmaps.
* Operate with speed and focus—driving clarity, momentum, and cross-functional alignment in a fast-paced environment.
* Continuously demonstrate deep customer empathy and intellectual curiosity.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Product Management, delivering impactful customer experiences and driving measurable business results.
* Highly collaborative, with strong influencing and communication skills across disciplines and levels.
* Excellent analytical skills; able to synthesize data and insights to inform decisions.
* Produced organizations that systematically and consistently drive incredible execution of awesome product experiences.
* Exude passion for delivering superb customer experiences.
* Exceptional drive - Applying the nuances of influencing based on the situation, knowing when to push and when to ease, driving through designs, ideas, and roadmaps.
* Learning mindset, curious, bold, self-aware, and humble.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Sr. Staff Product Manager - Finance Systems
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit is seeking a talented Staff Product Manager to join our Finance tech team and spearhead our Enterprise Finance product initiatives. As a Staff PM, you will bring your curiosity, business acumen, and customer insight to create innovative solutions, solving significant problems in the world of Enterprise Finance. As part of our Product organization, you will partner closely with the Engineering team and cross-functional business teams to drive exceptional customer and employee experience.

What will you bring:

Knowledge and/or experience in finance transformation & strategy like Source to Report, Order to Cash & Record to Report and similar technologies is highly desirable

* Experience in building value case for strategic initiatives like ERP Cloud Upgrade or SaaS Implementations
* Experience in Oracle Financials Applications preferably ERP Cloud or similar technology - core Finance Modules of General Ledger, Intercompany, Procure to Pay, Fixed Assets, Projects, Accounting, XLA, Cash Management. Understanding of how technology works between Oracle and other Third Party Applications.
* Demonstrated experience in building scalable applications that solve complex business problems, with a strong product mindset and expertise across the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC). Proven ability to lead the development of new applications, drive successful delivery, and manage, operate, and scale solutions that support Finance business capabilities.
* Strong understanding and knowledge of application of modern AI driven technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI/ML driven analytics
* As a cross-functional partner, lead technical discussions and be a thought leader during product reviews and be responsible for designing and executing process and strategy frameworks that facilitate product-related goal setting, decision making, and business impact.
* Ability to develop and execute a successful product roadmap, prioritize between features and architectural improvements and establish the operational rigor for building and improving the existing portfolio
* Data and metrics driven with a “win together” mindset and track record of performance excellence, i.e. consistently delivering exceptional results, exceeding targets and objectives
* Experience with AI based, Agile development and methodologies
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to think and lead complex projects simultaneously
* Effective and persuasive presentations (verbal and written) skills
* Ability to influence program/product direction and simplify complexity.

**Responsibilities**

As the Sr. Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Finance, you will lead a cross-functional effort to ideate and build the technology and ecosystem for enterprise planning and digital transformation. You will be responsible for deeply understanding the customers and the business processes, prioritizing customer needs, and defining and executing on a product roadmap to push the boundaries of digital process automation. Other key responsibilities include:

* Designing and implementing enterprise planning and prioritization technologies that connect strategy and execution for significant business outcomes
* Leading efforts to identify systemic, organizational-wide problems and building strong relationships to influence problem-solving
* Bring thought leadership to influence stakeholders during product reviews, leading technical discussions
* Performing data-driven analysis to make sound decisions and influence business direction
* Planning, managing, and executing end-to-end projects, ensuring timely delivery
* Conducting competitive analysis, staying abreast of industry trends and innovations
* Aligning on consensus around product roadmap priorities, balancing short-term vs. long-term customer outcomes across the team
* Engaging Senior Leadership Team (SLT) effectively
* Managing product development lifecycles, including managing cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution and delivery of products
* Continuously evaluating product fit/gap, process optimization, ascertaining technical dependencies and maturity, performing external benchmarking, and recommending options that meet the long-term vision.
* Provide hands-on program management during analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and post-implementation phases.

Overall, you will be responsible for leading the charge in driving digital transformation within Enterprise Finance, leveraging your customer insight, natural curiosity, and business acumen to develop features and functionalities that solve complex problems and drive significant customer and employee delight.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of software industry experience, including systems engineering, hardware engineering, or technical product/program management experience.
* Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems.
* Experience communicating and presenting work to senior leadership and framing discussions to gain valuable feedback.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to lead complex projects simultaneously.
* Experience with Agile development and methodologies.
* Must be data and metrics-driven with a “win together” mindset and a track record of performance excellence, consistently delivering exceptional results, exceeding targets and objectives.
* Manage product development lifecycles, including managing cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution and delivery of products.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

author: Hiring Manager
title: AVP Product Owner - Oracle Finance
job_description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Director – Financial Systems for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The Senior Director – Financial Systems serves as Finance’s product owner for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, with responsibility for translating Finance and Accounting priorities into scalable system capabilities, standardized processes and well-controlled solutions. The role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A and IT to establish the platform roadmap, govern functional design and investment priorities, and strengthen the systems and processes supporting close, planning, reporting and decision support.

**Primary Role – Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Product Ownership**

  

* Own the functional product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, aligning investments to Finance strategy and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead Finance’s role in implementation and enhancement programs from business case and process design through requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Serve as the senior Finance functional leader for Oracle Fusion Financials, including General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Intercompany, Tax, Subledger Accounting and financial reporting, and guide connected Procurement and Project Management scope as applicable.
* Lead product ownership for Oracle EPM across planning, consolidation, close, account reconciliation, enterprise data management and management reporting, enabling an integrated and scalable plan-to-report process.
* Establish governance for demand intake, prioritization, change control, release planning and executive decisions; communicate trade-offs, risks and realized value to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with IT to define Finance requirements for integrations and data flows across Fusion ERP, EPM and adjacent applications, establish reconciliation and control standards, and ensure timely resolution and escalation of material issues.
* Establish and maintain master data governance across ERP and EPM, including clear ownership, standards, stewardship and approval processes in partnership with key business stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong financial systems control environment, including role-based access, segregation of duties, workflow approvals, change management, audit evidence and SOX compliance.
* Lead Finance readiness and user adoption for Oracle quarterly releases and other platform changes, including impact assessment, testing, process documentation, training, communication and change management.
* Lead and develop the Financial Systems team, establishing clear performance expectations, building functional and technical capability, and ensuring appropriate capacity to support implementation and ongoing platform ownership.
* Manage Finance’s relationship with key implementation partners, consultants and technology vendors, ensuring alignment with functional priorities, delivery expectations and business outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement across Finance processes and systems, identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve reporting and decision support.
* undefined

* **QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
  + Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, information systems, business administration or a related field is required; MBA, CPA, CA or other relevant advanced credential is preferred.
  + 12+ years of progressive financial systems, finance transformation, ERP/EPM product management or related consulting and industry experience.
  + At least five years of leadership experience managing teams and large cross-functional business transformation initiatives.
  + Deep functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM, including core financial close, planning, consolidation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
  + Demonstrated leadership of at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion ERP and/or Oracle EPM implementation, major transformation or global rollout through post-production stabilization.
  + Experience with fit-to-standard design, functional configuration, data conversion, integration coordination, testing, deployment, release management and change adoption.
  + Strong understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, SOX or comparable control environments, and audit requirements for cloud financial applications.
  + Demonstrated ability to translate finance process requirements into system design and challenge unnecessary customization.
  + Ability to balance strategic product leadership with disciplined execution, resolve complex cross-functional issues and make sound, timely decisions.
  + Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and executive presentation skills; real estate, asset-intensive, multi-entity or highly regulated industry experience is preferred.
  + Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during system implementations, quarter-end and year-end close, major releases and other peak periods.
  + Partner with US-based leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, performance management and organizational development to ensure the Financial Systems team has the appropriate capacity and capabilities to support the business.
  + Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

*Job Applicant Privacy Notice*

***EEO Statement***

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant, employee, or other covered person based on any legally recognized basis, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, caste, immigration status, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation or related medical conditions), age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected leave status, domestic violence victim status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please email* *TalentAcquisitionIndia@revantage.com*

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Director – Financial Systems for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The Senior Director – Financial Systems serves as Finance’s product owner for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, with responsibility for translating Finance and Accounting priorities into scalable system capabilities, standardized processes and well-controlled solutions. The role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A and IT to establish the platform roadmap, govern functional design and investment priorities, and strengthen the systems and processes supporting close, planning, reporting and decision support.

**Primary Role – Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Product Ownership**

  

* Own the functional product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Cloud EPM, aligning investments to Finance strategy and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead Finance’s role in implementation and enhancement programs from business case and process design through requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Serve as the senior Finance functional leader for Oracle Fusion Financials, including General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Intercompany, Tax, Subledger Accounting and financial reporting, and guide connected Procurement and Project Management scope as applicable.
* Lead product ownership for Oracle EPM across planning, consolidation, close, account reconciliation, enterprise data management and management reporting, enabling an integrated and scalable plan-to-report process.
* Establish governance for demand intake, prioritization, change control, release planning and executive decisions; communicate trade-offs, risks and realized value to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with IT to define Finance requirements for integrations and data flows across Fusion ERP, EPM and adjacent applications, establish reconciliation and control standards, and ensure timely resolution and escalation of material issues.
* Establish and maintain master data governance across ERP and EPM, including clear ownership, standards, stewardship and approval processes in partnership with key business stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong financial systems control environment, including role-based access, segregation of duties, workflow approvals, change management, audit evidence and SOX compliance.
* Lead Finance readiness and user adoption for Oracle quarterly releases and other platform changes, including impact assessment, testing, process documentation, training, communication and change management.
* Lead and develop the Financial Systems team, establishing clear performance expectations, building functional and technical capability, and ensuring appropriate capacity to support implementation and ongoing platform ownership.
* Manage Finance’s relationship with key implementation partners, consultants and technology vendors, ensuring alignment with functional priorities, delivery expectations and business outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement across Finance processes and systems, identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve reporting and decision support.
* undefined

  + Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, information systems, business administration or a related field is required; MBA, CPA, CA or other relevant advanced credential is preferred.
  + 12+ years of progressive financial systems, finance transformation, ERP/EPM product management or related consulting and industry experience.
  + At least five years of leadership experience managing teams and large cross-functional business transformation initiatives.
  + Deep functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM, including core financial close, planning, consolidation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
  + Demonstrated leadership of at least one full-cycle Oracle Fusion ERP and/or Oracle EPM implementation, major transformation or global rollout through post-production stabilization.
  + Experience with fit-to-standard design, functional configuration, data conversion, integration coordination, testing, deployment, release management and change adoption.
  + Strong understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, SOX or comparable control environments, and audit requirements for cloud financial applications.
  + Demonstrated ability to translate finance process requirements into system design and challenge unnecessary customization.

job_description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

*Summary:*

The Staff Technical Product Manager supports the structured execution, adoption, and expansion of Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role works across product, business, engineering, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders to translate agreed product direction into organized backlogs, coordinated delivery routines, documented decisions, transparent progress, user feedback, effective communications, and transition readiness.

The position helps teams scale capabilities already built by improving reuse, documentation, communication, adoption, and expansion readiness. It also supports new initiatives by coordinating discovery activities, workshops, stakeholder inputs, feedback, dependencies, and follow-through.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong background in Data & AI strategy definition and implementation, coupled with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience in people management and a deep understanding of the business and technology landscape are also highly desirable.

If you are a strategic thinker, a passionate advocate for Data & AI innovation, and a collaborative leader, this Director of AI Strategy role presents an exciting opportunity to drive the organization's digital transformation and shape the future of its AI capabilities.

*Duties and Responsibilities:*

1. Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.

2. Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.

3. Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.

4. Ensure progress visibility for infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other enabling initiatives by aggregating updates from responsible owners and highlighting significant dependencies or risks

5. Organize and facilitate discovery, product, business, and engineering workshops after the product vision and strategic direction have been established; prepare objectives and pre-work, coordinate participants, capture decisions, and track actions.

6. Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.

7. Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.

8. Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.

9. Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.

10. Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

*Minimum Qualifications:* (To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)

* University degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* A good understanding of various Data platforms, Cloud or on-prem (Datalake, DWH, Datamarts, Document management, Data interoperability (ETL, API mgt)
* Abilities to define a data & AI platform as a service for enabling other IT teams to benefit from it.

* 7-10 years of overall professional experience in product management, technology program management, digital delivery, data and analytics, business transformation, product operations, or a related field.
* At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable Product Manager, Product Operations, Agile Program, or technology delivery coordination role.
* Experience running Agile or Scrum ceremonies and maintaining backlogs across one or more business and technology initiatives.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position is one that would normally require the person to work in a temperature-controlled office environment with other professional and management employees and continent workers, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.
* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.
* This position will likely require the employee to travel a few times annually to physically meet with managers or team members.

*About You*

* You bring structure and momentum to complex initiatives without adding unnecessary process.
* You are confident facilitating Scrum ceremonies and product discussions with Engineering Managers, technical leads, senior developers, business stakeholders, and users.
* You can convert product direction and workshop discussions into clear backlog items, decisions, requirements, actions, and communication materials.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder commitments.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally and can prepare concise, leadership-ready presentations and pre-read materials.
* You listen carefully to users, separate observations from requirements, document feedback objectively, and support evidence-based prioritization.
* You can challenge missing information, unclear ownership, delayed actions, or unmanaged dependencies constructively and respectfully.
* You understand the difference between tracking engineering progress and managing technical quality or individual developer performance.
* You are motivated by scalable outcomes and help teams reuse, document, communicate, adopt, and expand capabilities already built.
* You are a collaborative self-starter who works within agreed portfolio strategy and product vision while taking ownership of execution discipline and follow-through.

**Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:**

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information**

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner / Technical Product Manager to lead the roadmap, backlog, and delivery of a complex digital platform. The role requires a unique blend of business acumen and technical expertise, with responsibility for translating business needs into clear requirements, driving platform strategy, and partnering closely with developers, architects, and global stakeholders.

The successful candidate will oversee integrations across CMS, eCommerce, product content and digital asset platforms, manage cross-functional dependencies, ensure platform stability and successful releases, and champion automation, modernization, and agile best practices while coaching engineering teams toward scalable, high-quality solutions.

### **Tasks**

* Ownership of backlog and roadmap — balancing new business features, operational needs, and technical debt into transparent priorities
* Translation of business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes
* Act as a strong technical sparring partner for developers, architects, and global tech leads, including deep-dive discussions on solution design, APIs, integrations and implementation approach.
* Overview of integrations and data flows across CMS, eCommerce, product content, asset delivery
* Dependency management across international teams
* Coach and guide developers on technical topics, engineering best practices, platform understanding, and solution thinking.
* Platform health — incident prioritization, root cause follow-up, corrective actions in the backlog
* Release coordination with development and operations
* Scrum ceremonies, automation and modernization opportunities

**Exciting insights into Rohde & Schwarz**
------------------------------------------

Our colleagues provide insider information about:

* Daily adventures and challenges
* Our passionate team
* The technologies behind the innovative projects and solutions

### **Qualifications**

* Degree in Business Information Systems, IT, Computer Science, or comparable background
* 5+ years in product ownership, digital product management or platform management
* 3+ years working directly with software development teams
* Backlog ownership for an integration-heavy product — interfaces, dependencies, operational topics
* Able to read a system landscape, follow data flows and API contracts, challenge technical trade-offs, translate in both directions
* Application operations and production support — incident prioritization, root cause follow-up
* Jira, Confluence, agile delivery (Scrum, Kanban, or Scrumban)
* Excellent English

  **Nice to Have**

  + PIM, DAM, CMS, product content or asset delivery — SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP PCM, FirstSpirit or comparable
  + REST APIs, event-driven architectures, integration patterns
  + AWS or Azure, cloud-native integration services
  + Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Grafana or CloudWatch, ServiceNow
  + Background in software development, solution engineering, or technical consulting

### **Contact and further information**

We welcome your application! Submissions are preferred online via the application portal. For questions, our chatbot Paul and the recruiting team are available at any time.

Rohde & Schwarz promotes equal opportunities and welcomes applications from people with and without disabilities. We offer an inclusive work environment where all individuals can develop their skills and talents regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, worldview, age, sexual orientation, identity, and other characteristics.

At Rohde & Schwarz, we develop and produce solutions in the fields of Test & Measurement, Technology Systems, and Networks & Cybersecurity – driven by the vision of a safer and connected world. From software to final production, our more than 15,000 employees create products and systems that set global standards and enable technological sovereignty for industrial, regulatory, and government customers worldwide. Our headquarters, located in the heart of Munich, also serves as our main development site. In India the company is present as Rohde & Schwarz India Pvt. Ltd (RSINDIA) which is 100% owned subsidiary of Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG, Germany, whose head office is located in New Delhi and branch offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Field presence at Ahmedabad, Chennai and Pune. With more than 10 channel partners situated at key industrial locations we serve across the country. Our emphasis is to provide outstanding sales, service and support to our customers. The company has invested sustainably to increase the local support capability as well as to provide a fully automated Calibration facility for most of the products sold. Rohde & Schwarz India has ISO 9001:2015 certified Quality Management Systems and ISO 17025 NABL Accreditation. The company continuously invests in training its service and sales personnel regularly to maintain a high level of technical competence in pre- and post-sales support and outstanding quality in services viz. Repairs, Calibration, Product support & Project management. Rohde & Schwarz India is a financially stable company rated by CRSIL as SME 1 for more than 5 years now. This rating is the highest in its category. Rohde & Schwarz India is committed to 100% customer satisfaction through innovative product offerings and outstanding support and services. Our comprehensive and continuously growing range of services are designed to provide customers with the highest level of quality and value throughout the life cycle of our products.

### **Our Offer**

* Allowance for home office equipment
* Flexible working hour models
* Possibility of car leasing
* Sports promotion
* Health care
* (Group) accident insurance
* Online medical counselling
* Life insurance
* Corporate/team events
* Gifts for special life events

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Service & Experience portfolio. **Key Responsibilities:**

  

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

* Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will lead and develop the Service & Experience product team and work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function.

The portfolio initially centres on ServiceNow HRSD and is expected to include Qualtrics and colleague-listening capabilities, alongside integrations with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise platforms.
* You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Service & Experience portfolio. **Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including product ownership, roadmap planning, workflow or service development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities and translating business requirements, service challenges and strategic objectives into measurable digital outcomes.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, service-management or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Strong understanding of HR service delivery, case management, service catalogues, knowledge management, employee and manager self-service and workflow automation.
* Experience designing or improving employee and manager journeys, services or lifecycle events across multiple business functions.
* Experience supporting global service standardisation while balancing regional, operational and regulatory requirements.
* Experience managing product demand, incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience owning delivery outcomes through internal teams, integrated delivery teams and third-party implementation or support partners.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and non-People functions to define responsibilities, requirements and hand-offs within cross-functional services or lifecycle journeys.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing product governance, processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy, service transformation and experience-design objectives.
* Experience using platform performance, service information, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continual improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification.
* ServiceNow HR Service Delivery implementation, product or specialist certification.
* Additional ServiceNow certifications relating to platform implementation, application development, workflow automation, service management or customer workflows.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise employee-service portfolios.
* Experience with Qualtrics or comparable colleague-listening, survey or experience-management platforms.
* Experience applying service design, experience design, journey mapping or user-centred design practices.
* Experience designing or managing global service catalogues, service taxonomies, case-management models or knowledge-management frameworks.
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle orchestration across People, IT, Security, Facilities, Procurement, Learning, identity or background-screening processes.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products or other enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating-model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, super-user groups, champion networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.

* ServiceNow HR Service Delivery certification

* Scrum Master
  

**Service and Experience Management**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification
* Service design or experience-design qualification
  

Journey-mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design certification

This role is expected to help build and mature the People Technology function and establish Service & Experience as a strategic product capability, rather than simply operate an established ServiceNow platform.

At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description**

About the Role
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive and manage the requirements and roadmap to transform and continuously improve the customer experience for a high-quality SaaS solution. You will define new product capabilities and integrations that streamline how customers are provisioned, onboarded, managed, as well as engage with our product. You will drive usability studies and business workflow research to recommend, design, and implement ways to increase the velocity at which we can meet customer needs. You will work across the company with all aspects of product delivery, including business operations, IT operations, sales, and support.
  
You will serve as the product owner for your area, coordinating product development teams and monitoring progress throughout the development cycle. You will manage pre-release product activities (beta, preview), and coordinate cross-functional teams for product launch and company readiness activities, including internal training. This role also provides a significant opportunity for leadership via cross-team collaboration with the other product teams and businesses to achieve our company goals.
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.
  
  
Required Skills- BA/BS degree is required
- Experience with Product Management methodology
- 7+ years of experience in B2B product management and product delivery
- Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate product management work (research, writing, analysis), alongside the judgment to identify and scope where AI/ML can meaningfully improve the product itself
- Prior experience working for a SaaS/Cloud company
- Familiar with modern, agile software/SaaS/Cloud development practices used to build and deploy web applications
- Experience working with colleagues and teams internationally.
- Experience working with a Product Marketing Management team
- Experience administering and overseeing beta programs as it relates to new product features and enhancements.
- Experience collaborating across product management as well as other teams
- Able to facilitate collaboration among individuals from various departments to achieve shared goals.
- Demonstrated track record of translating customer requirements into market-leading solutions.
- Must have excellent written, presentation and verbal communication skills
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with Budgeting and Planning applications and understanding of multi-dimensional concepts
- Background in Accounting / FP&A / budgeting is an advantage.
  
  
#LI-RT

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Responsibilities- Guide the roadmap for a budgeting and planning product that is part of an offering that includes core financials and workforce planning
- Conduct and use data, research and customer interviews to understand the customer's needs and translate them to business insights and product requirements
- Managed beta activities related to new product features and enhancements.
- Utilize market assessments, analytics, and insights to strategically prioritize features, monitor their performance after launch, and guide roadmap planning.
- Write detailed requirement documents that are necessary for the engineering organization to implement business operations enhancements and integrations
- Define and track product and feature success metrics and use them to create best practices, documentation, use cases, and other supporting materials that make our customers successful
- Execute the details of our product strategy, ensure product launches, feature updates, and other initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and with exceptional functionality and usability.
- Collaborate with Business Operations, IT Operations, Support, Sales, and Product leadership on the vision for Sage Intacct business systems, including provisioning, pricing, tenant management, and integrations
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure a successful launch of solutions through training, support, and sales
  
  
  
#LI-RT

title: Senior Product Manager (Salesforce Integration)
job_description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “**name@cvent.com**” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

**About the role:**

Cvent's acquisition strategy has brought together some of the most recognized names in event technology, each with their own Salesforce-native application used by event marketers and meeting professionals worldwide. As we integrate these businesses, we're creating a dedicated role to bring unified ownership, strategic clarity, and a cohesive customer experience across our entire Salesforce app portfolio.  
This is a high-impact, high-visibility position for a senior product leader who thrives at the intersection of CRM ecosystems, enterprise SaaS, and portfolio strategy. You'll be the single accountable owner across five Salesforce applications — setting the overarching strategy, driving day-to-day roadmap decisions, and ensuring Cvent stays ahead of Salesforce's evolving platform requirements.

In This Role, You Will::

Own a Portfolio of Salesforce Products  

* Serve as the single accountable owner across a portfolio of five Salesforce-native applications spanning our event technology brands — setting strategy, driving roadmap decisions, and ensuring a consistent customer experience.
* Lead our flagship Salesforce application as your core product, managing its end-to-end roadmap and balancing new feature investment against technical debt.
* Shepherd an acquired application from beta through General Availability, working closely with customers and go-to-market teams to define readiness criteria and launch successfully.
* Partner with PMs across acquired brands to align product direction and ensure cohesion across the portfolio.
* Where leadership decides to consolidate apps, own the migration workstream — defining requirements and partnering with Customer Success to ensure a seamless transition for customers.

Define the Salesforce Strategy  

* Determine whether and how Cvent moves toward a unified Salesforce app experience across acquired brands.
* Keep all applications ahead of mandatory Salesforce platform updates, security requirements, and AppExchange compliance changes.
* Make high-stakes prioritization calls across five products simultaneously — where to invest, what to consolidate, and how to sequence the roadmap.
* Embed AI as a default lens across product decisions; champion AI-native processes within your team.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment  

* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions across the portfolio; own escalation paths and surface risks proactively.
* Lead alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, UX, and acquired-company partners.
* Use data — analytics platforms, customer feedback, and OKRs — to guide prioritization and communicate progress to leadership.

Here's What You Need::

* 12+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with direct experience shipping Salesforce-native or deeply integrated CRM products.
* Salesforce AppExchange or managed package experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-product roadmaps — especially in post-acquisition or multi-brand environments.
* Experience owning customer migration or product consolidation workstreams.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and a track record of embedding AI into PM workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using platforms like Mixpanel or similar to drive adoption and measure impact.
* Exceptional communicator — comfortable aligning leadership team, engineering, and external partners around a shared product vision.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “**name@cvent.com**” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

**About the role:**

Cvent's acquisition strategy has brought together some of the most recognized names in event technology, each with their own Salesforce-native application used by event marketers and meeting professionals worldwide. As we integrate these businesses, we're creating a dedicated role to bring unified ownership, strategic clarity, and a cohesive customer experience across our entire Salesforce app portfolio.  
This is a high-impact, high-visibility position for a senior product leader who thrives at the intersection of CRM ecosystems, enterprise SaaS, and portfolio strategy. You'll be the single accountable owner across five Salesforce applications — setting the overarching strategy, driving day-to-day roadmap decisions, and ensuring Cvent stays ahead of Salesforce's evolving platform requirements.

In This Role, You Will::

Own a Portfolio of Salesforce Products  

* Serve as the single accountable owner across a portfolio of five Salesforce-native applications spanning our event technology brands — setting strategy, driving roadmap decisions, and ensuring a consistent customer experience.
* Lead our flagship Salesforce application as your core product, managing its end-to-end roadmap and balancing new feature investment against technical debt.
* Shepherd an acquired application from beta through General Availability, working closely with customers and go-to-market teams to define readiness criteria and launch successfully.
* Partner with PMs across acquired brands to align product direction and ensure cohesion across the portfolio.
* Where leadership decides to consolidate apps, own the migration workstream — defining requirements and partnering with Customer Success to ensure a seamless transition for customers.

Define the Salesforce Strategy  

* Determine whether and how Cvent moves toward a unified Salesforce app experience across acquired brands.
* Keep all applications ahead of mandatory Salesforce platform updates, security requirements, and AppExchange compliance changes.
* Make high-stakes prioritization calls across five products simultaneously — where to invest, what to consolidate, and how to sequence the roadmap.
* Embed AI as a default lens across product decisions; champion AI-native processes within your team.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment  

* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions across the portfolio; own escalation paths and surface risks proactively.
* Lead alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, UX, and acquired-company partners.
* Use data — analytics platforms, customer feedback, and OKRs — to guide prioritization and communicate progress to leadership.

Here's What You Need::

* 12+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with direct experience shipping Salesforce-native or deeply integrated CRM products.
* Salesforce AppExchange or managed package experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-product roadmaps — especially in post-acquisition or multi-brand environments.
* Experience owning customer migration or product consolidation workstreams.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and a track record of embedding AI into PM workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using platforms like Mixpanel or similar to drive adoption and measure impact.
* Exceptional communicator — comfortable aligning leadership team, engineering, and external partners around a shared product vision.
