job_description:
**About Turing**
================

Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

**About the Role**

Turing is looking for a high-caliber Product Manager to lead critical product areas across our talent, marketplace, vetting, and platform ecosystem. This person will step into a high-ownership role and should be able to combine strong product judgment, design taste, data-driven decision making, technical fluency, and structured business thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of user experience, systems thinking, analytics, and execution — someone who is equally comfortable shaping product direction, defining elegant user experiences, and driving cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment.

**Why this role matters**

Turing works with many of the world's leading AI labs and enterprises to help build, improve, and scale advanced AI systems. We sit at the intersection of frontier AI, high-quality talent, and complex product/platform workflows - which means the problems here are real, hard, and highly consequential.

This role sits at the core of how Turing builds scalable, high-quality experiences across talent and customer workflows. The right person will help raise the bar on product execution, clarity of thinking, and quality of experience across the organization.

**What you'll own**

You will lead product strategy and execution across some of Turing's most important platform surfaces, including areas such as:

* Talent discovery, search, and matching
* Talent onboarding and profile quality
* Vetting, trust, and integrity systems
* Marketplace workflows and hiring manager experience
* Internal platforms and operational tooling
* Cross-functional product initiatives spanning product, engineering, design, data, and operations

**What you'll do**

* Own roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a core product area
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured product plans, clear requirements, and strong execution
* Drive product development with a sharp eye for user experience, workflow design, and quality
* Use data deeply to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, prioritize investments, and measure impact
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, QA, and operations to ship high-quality products quickly
* Balance short-term execution with long-term product and platform thinking
* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems
* High ownership, urgency, and a strong bias for execution

**Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or a similarly rigorous discipline, ideally from a top-tier institution such as IIT or equivalent globally recognized universities
* MBA from a top-tier university is a plus, but not required
* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products
* Strong track record of partnering closely with engineering and design teams to ship polished, high-quality user experiences

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**
----------

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**Advantages of joining Turing**
--------------------------------

* **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
* **Contribute to leading-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
* **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
* **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
* **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

  

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

job_description:
Roles & Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – POS to own the strategy, roadmap, customer

experience, and business outcomes for Ginesys’s POS portfolio across Cloud POS, Offline

POS, Mobile POS, and omnichannel store journeys. You will combine deep retail and POS

expertise with strong product craft to modernise a mission-critical store platform and shape

the future of intelligent store commerce.

Key Responsibilities

1. POS Product Strategy, Market & Discovery

● Own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile,

and Omnichannel POS within Ginesys One.

● Build deep understanding of retailers, store associates, market shifts, and global

POS competition to identify whitespace and differentiated product bets.

● Prioritise roadmap investments using customer value, market opportunity,

competitive advantage, revenue potential, and ROI; distinguish scalable needs from

one-off customisation.

● Shape the modernisation and migration strategy for existing POS capabilities while

protecting continuity for enterprise retailers.

2. Modern Store & Omnichannel Experience

● Reimagine core store journeys across billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, returns,

inventory visibility, assisted selling, and endless aisle.

● Design seamless experiences across stores, e-commerce, marketplaces, and

customer channels, including Mobile POS and checkout-anywhere experiences.

● Own product quality across speed, usability, reliability, offline resilience, multi-device

environments, and high-volume enterprise store networks.

3. Platform, Architecture & Product Execution

● Partner deeply with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, data flows, sync, security,

performance, observability, extensibility, and backward compatibility.

● Ensure seamless integration with ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM, loyalty, payments, tax,

e-commerce, and third- party retail ecosystems.

● Translate strategy into crisp requirements, prototypes, workflows, and measurable

release outcomes; make sound trade-offs between speed, technical foundations, and

long-term platform leverage.

● Lead cross-functional execution with Design, Engineering, QA, Customer Success,

and Implementation from discovery through launch and adoption.

4. AI-First Store Innovation

● Identify meaningful AI-native opportunities across checkout, associate assistance,

store operations, recommendations, automation, fraud/risk, and customer

experience.

● Use contemporary AI and rapid prototyping tools hands-on to validate concepts

faster and explore intelligent assistance, natural-language interfaces, and agentic

store workflows.

● Challenge legacy retail workflows and help define what an intelligent, connected

store experience should look like for the next decade.

5. Business Outcomes, Adoption & Monetisation

● Own measurable outcomes across adoption, usage depth, customer satisfaction,

retention, revenue influence, and expansion.

● Define success metrics before launch, track post-launch performance, and use data

and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

● Partner with Sales and Marketing on positioning, packaging, competitive

differentiation, and monetisation; equip Customer Success and Support to drive

adoption and customer value.

Pay: ₹2,730,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Must have a minimum of 8 years of experience in product management with significant ownership of POS
* Must have experience leading a product team and owning the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Cloud, Offline, and Mobile POS
* Must have experience building enterprise-grade products requiring offline resilience, high availability, and large-scale integrations (ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM)
* Must have experience in omnichannel retail journeys including billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, and inventory visibility
* Must have experience in SaaS product lifecycle management and ERP integrations
* Must be willing to work from the Gurgaon office 5 days a week and attend a face-to-face final interview round

Work Location: In person

title: 10.Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About** **PayPay India**
--------------------------

PayPay, a fintech company providing a service enjoyed by over 75 million users since its launch in 2018 in Japan. The company is now home to a very diverse team of members from more than 50 countries. We grew to a team of several thousand employees in Japan but are far from over. We are still in the Day 1. Every day, new members join us from all over the world to create new value and deliver it to society.

**Why India ?**
---------------

To build our Payment services, we got technical cooperation from Paytm (A large payment service company in India). And based on their customer-first technologies , we created and expanded the smartphone payment service in Japan. Therefore, we have decided to establish a development base in India, because it is a major IT country with many talented engineers, as evidenced by the fact that cutting-edge mobile payments can continue to be generated.

**OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED**
---------------------------

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realise a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined.

**AI-First Culture at PayPay**
------------------------------

At PayPay, we believe the future of software development is AI-augmented engineering. Every engineer is expected to actively leverage AI tools for code reviews, testing, documentation, debugging, and productivity improvements. AI is not optional — it is a mandatory part of our daily engineering workflow. Candidates must demonstrate both hands-on experience and the right mindset to integrate AI effectively into their workflow, while maintaining the engineering rigor, ownership, and problem-solving skills that only humans can provide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **Overview**

PayPay India is seeking an autonomous **Senior Product Manager** to own and drive critical credit and merchant financial products in close collaboration with PayPay group companies.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end product execution, turning business requirements into scalable platform features and seamless end-user experiences. You will work independently on day-to-day execution while collaborating closely with business partners, credit modeling experts, data teams, and engineering to deliver high-impact financial products in Japan.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* **Product Ownership & Execution:** Drive end-to-end product lifecycle for merchant credit and bank integration products from ideation to launch.
* **Cross-Entity Collaboration:** Act as the key product owner working independently with business teams, partner banks, and PayPay group companies in Japan to understand business needs and translate them into actionable product roadmaps.
* **Technical Specifications & Architecture:** Write clear, high-quality PRDs and partner closely with engineering and UI/UX teams to build scalable platform capabilities and clean user experiences.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment with Modeling Teams:** Collaborate with credit modeling, risk, and analytics teams to seamlessly incorporate scoring models, data pipelines, and decision engines into product flows.
* **Data-Driven Optimization:** Analyze product performance, user behavior, and platform metrics using SQL and analytical tools to continuously identify feature gaps and optimize customer experiences.
* **Roadmap Prioritization:** Define product challenges and opportunities, balancing speed of execution with long-term platform scalability.

### **Qualifications :**

#### **Required Qualifications**

title: Sr. Product Manager - Master Data Management
job_description:
**It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!**

Job Description:

**Sr. Product Manager – Master Data Management**

Ingram Micro is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Manager to drive the roadmap and execution of key master data initiatives that shape the foundation of how our business operates. This is an important role in Ingram Micro's company-wide master data transformation journey — helping build the data structures, governance frameworks, and product experiences that power trusted, consistent, and scalable data across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.

**You Will:**

* Drive the product roadmap and execution for one or more master data domains by deeply understanding business needs, data quality challenges, and the evolving enterprise data landscape.
* Advance a unified approach to master data — including product, customer, vendor, and financial data domains — ensuring consistency, accuracy, and accessibility across the organization.
* Design and improve data governance processes, data stewardship workflows, and master data lifecycle management experiences that empower business users and reduce friction.
* Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Analytics, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations teams to define, develop, and launch master data solutions and capabilities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement to eliminate data quality issues, reduce manual data handling, and deliver measurable business outcomes such as time savings, cost reduction, and improved decision-making.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to understand how master data flows across systems, identify gaps, and lead initiatives that improve data reliability and trustworthiness across the enterprise.
* Monitor and analyze the health and adoption of master data products, using insights to inform the ongoing transformation roadmap.

**You Have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross-functional go-to-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of analytics tools such as Looker or Adobe Analytics, as well as data pipeline or integration concepts, preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.

title: Product Manager, AI
job_description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

### **What you'll do:**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Why Work for Us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
